I've confirmed it to Tobias in a thread reply on his #central-team message: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is for 382 seats.

I couldn't check that number against anything. I looked through the account files I can see, and there's nothing for Marrow, so the figure rests on his word alone. I told him that in the reply. As he asked, I took no other action.
